description: Miracle Claw chat window — hosts the bundled chat gateway at localhost:28789. Loaded as a separate webview so the dashboard (main window) is not navigated away when the user opens chat. The launcher sidecar is already spawned by the main window; this window just consumes the running gateway. (rc56.0 Bucket 2 rename: was 'openclaw.json' / 'openclaw-capability' / 'openclaw-chat' before Week 6 migration.)
